notes.title: Patch v0.1.5.11
notes.notes: Win sequence changed from launching straight after shark kill to launching when you activate portal after shark. It should fix all bugs related to what happens after shark kill. Also fixed additional missions UI on arena boss. And fixed some visual and UI bugs on client side.

notes.title: Tutorial update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Tutorial [/h1]
Tutorial was added to the game! It will teach you the basics of shooting, using abilities, buying items and interacting with additional missions!

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
- Interact tooltip on buttons setting change.
- No revive capsule on revive button press
- Drones teleports animations on archers ultimate 
- Train mission auto win
- Tab doesn't sow some items on client in hub interactions
- Ninja turtles achievement bug
- Empty accept all on clearing saves after completing achievements 

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- Projectiles color on Shark boss arena changed color from red to blue for improved visibility
- Mobs spawn rates decreased on Normal and Easy difficulties.
